smoothie noun

also smoothies, make smoothies

* our formation

* (our own formation) pōtiō, pōtiōnis f.

noun, third declension · Declension on Wiktionary

drink

Our short contextual word for a smoothie. The noun is pōtiō with long ō (L&S pōtio; cf. pōtus, pōtāre); the earlier short-o spelling was corrected on 23 October 2026.

Other words

  • * (our own formation) pōtiō ex pōmīs holeribusque contrītīs — a drink made from blended fruit and vegetables

    also used · * our formation

    Our explicit description, not a claimed standard Neo-Latin headword. The drink label and complete smoothie phrase are our working descriptions. Crassus/tenuis describe consistency; dulcis, acidus and amārus describe sweetness, sourness and bitterness.

Examples

  • Theodōre, pōtiōnem ūnā parēmus.

    Theo, let’s make a smoothie together.composed

  • Vīs pōtiōnem viridem an dulcem?

    Would you like a green smoothie or a sweet one?composed

  • Cucumerem mihi porrige, quaesō.

    Pass me the cucumber, please.composed

See also blender, blend, juice, thick, thin.
